scheme.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Mukhmantri Sehat Bima Yojana
scheme.spoken_name: Punjab Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana
scheme.implementing_agency: State Health Agency Punjab, National Health Authority
scheme.description: Flagship State Health Insurance Scheme for Punjab. Launched 20 August 2019. Covers 65% of Punjab population. Cashless and paperless treatment at Government and empaneled private hospitals. Rs 5 lakh per family per year. Covers 1579 treatment packages including pre-hospitalization (3 days) and post-hospitalization (15 days). Entitlement-based scheme; no separate enrollment for identified families. E-card generation via Ayushman App or beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
scheme.voice_summary: In Punjab, the Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana gives eligible families cashless hospital treatment of up to 5 lakh rupees per family per year.
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Must be a resident of Punjab

benefits.text: Cashless health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year
